snippet.title: Island of Rebirth~NTR and Love~｜Trailer
snippet.description:
A mysterious island suddenly appears at sea. Rick, a protagonist suffering from amnesia, encounters two beautiful girls, Sienna and Mila. The three embark on a journey of exploration across the island. During their adventure, Rick gradually develops feelings for both of them—and these feelings will determine the fate of the story...

Developer: AVANTGARDE
